summary: ChildWorkflowOptions lacks the WorkflowIDConflictPolicy field that exists in StartWorkflowOptions, forcing users to use the deprecated WorkflowIDReusePolicy for child workflows and preventing full migration away from deprecated APIs.
userImpact: Users are forced to use the deprecated WorkflowIDReusePolicy for child workflows instead of the newer WorkflowIDConflictPolicy, preventing full migration away from deprecated APIs.
rootCause: WorkflowIDConflictPolicy was added to StartWorkflowOptions in v1.26.0 but ChildWorkflowOptions was not updated in parallel. Server-side work (temporal/temporal#6799) is also required.
proposedFix: Add WorkflowIDConflictPolicy field to ChildWorkflowOptions to mirror the field in StartWorkflowOptions.
keyQuote: WorkflowIDConflictPolicy was added to StartWorkflowOptions in v1.26.0, but ChildWorkflowOptions has never been updated to include an equivalent field
